mov->current_top_box_start is set to the current bitstream position plus mov->bytes_removed before parsing each top-level box and again after processing it.

values.claim: For the first MDAT (or SIDX/SSIX/STYP when moov exists and no first_data_toplevel_offset yet), mov->first_data_toplevel_offset is set to mov->current_top_box_start and mov->first_data_toplevel_size to a->size.
mov->main_sidx_end_pos is set to mov->current_top_box_start + a->size for a SIDX box when NextMoofNumber is zero.
For a SIDX box in signal_frag_bounds mode, mov->sidx_start_offset is set to mov->current_top_box_start and mov->sidx_end_offset to the current bitstream position.
For a STYP box in signal_frag_bounds mode, mov->styp_start_offset is set to mov->current_top_box_start.
In KEEP_FRAGMENTS mode, mov->NextMoofNumber is set to mov->moof->mfhd->sequence_number + 1.
For an unknown box with original_4cc JP, box->data is treated as a u8 pointer c, and c[0..3] are read only when box->dataSize == 4.

When a MOOV box is accepted, mov->original_moov_offset is set to mov->current_top_box_start.
When a META box is accepted, mov->original_meta_offset is set to mov->current_top_box_start.
In READ mode with signal_frag_bounds and not FRAG_READ_DEBUG, mdat_end is set to the current bitstream position after an MDAT box.
pos is the result of gf_list_del_item(mov->TopBoxes, mov->brand); if pos < 0 it is set to 0 before inserting brand into mov->TopBoxes.

executions.claim: When bytes_removed is nonzero, totSize is asserted to be >= bytes_removed and then reduced by bytes_removed before seeking.
After gf_isom_parse_root_box returns e >= 0, a must be non-NULL; otherwise the function returns GF_ISOM_INVALID_FILE.

On GF_ISOM_INCOMPLETE_FILE, if openMode != GF_ISOM_OPEN_READ the function returns GF_ISOM_INVALID_FILE; if openMode == GF_ISOM_OPEN_READ and not progressive_mode it breaks out of the loop; otherwise it returns e.
A second MOOV box causes the function to delete the box and return GF_ISOM_INVALID_FILE.
After adding a MOOV, if mov->moov->mvhd is NULL the function returns GF_ISOM_INVALID_FILE.
A second META box causes the function to delete the box and return GF_ISOM_INVALID_FILE.
A second FTYP box causes the function to delete the box and return GF_ISOM_INVALID_FILE.
A second OTYP box causes the function to delete the box and return GF_ISOM_INVALID_FILE.
A second PDIN box causes the function to delete the box and return GF_ISOM_INVALID_FILE.
On MOOF with single_moof_mode set, single_moof_state is incremented; if it exceeds 1 the box is deleted and the function returns GF_OK.
After the loop, if none of moov, meta, moof, or is_index_segment is set, the function returns GF_ISOM_INCOMPLETE_FILE.
Unless the core no-check option is set, if moov exists but moov->mvhd is NULL the function returns GF_ISOM_INVALID_FILE.
Unless the core no-check option is set, if meta exists but meta->handler is NULL the function returns GF_ISOM_INVALID_FILE.
